mistake_reason: The CSVProcessing_Expert explicitly stated they would count applicants missing exactly one qualification, but implemented a filter with (df['Missing Qualifications'] <= 1).sum(), which counts both exactly one and zero missing qualifications. This is a direct reasoning-action mismatch: the plan (exactly one) conflicts with the action (at most one), leading to an incorrect inflated count reported as 23 instead of the ground truth 17.
